item.description:
• Scan and clean developer leftovers from Xcode, JavaScript, Rust, Go, Python, Java, Android, Flutter, .NET, PHP, Ruby and more
  • Clear old Claude Code and Codex sessions, editor caches and local AI model downloads
  • Uninstall apps together with their caches, preferences, containers and other files
  • Review every item with its size and last use, recent work stays unselected
  • Animated scan orb, keyboard shortcuts, launch at login and automatic updates
